author: HuggingModels
text: Meet TIGER-GGUF, a powerful text generation model that blends Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 with a massive 146T token corpus. It's built for multilingual tasks, especially English and Hindi, making it a versatile tool for developers.

author: HuggingModels
text: Use TIGER-GGUF for chatbots, content creation, translation, and code generation. As a GGUF quantized model, it runs efficiently on consumer hardware, perfect for local deployment or apps needing fast, on-device AI.
